snapshot.note: Fixed production infrastructure only. Per-launch token addresses are dynamic protocol output.

nativeManager.role: Implementation used by the current Native manager proxy.

prismManager.role: Implementation shared by all current Prism manager proxies.

dividendProcessor.role: Implementation selected by the production dividend processor proxy.

mixedHookFactory.role: CREATE2 factory used to deploy the current production mixed-fee hook.

legacyDividendHookFactory.role: Earlier V2 dividend-hook CREATE2 factory retained in the shared manifest; not the factory of the current mixed-fee hook.

lpVault.role: 48-hour timelocked custody and automation vault for Uniswap v4 LP NFTs.

dividendController.role: Registers launch tokens and coordinates dividend accounting/distribution.

dividendProcessor.role: Upgradeable processor used for holder dividend distributions.

tokenFactory.role: Deploys RobinhoodMixedFeeLaunchToken instances for V2 launches.

poolDeployer.role: Initializes post-bond pools and deposits LP NFTs into the V2 vault.

dividendFeeHelper.role: Splits and routes post-bond protocol, referral, and dividend fees.

mixedFeeHook.role: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for protocol fees and token-holder dividends.

referralRegistry.role: V1 referral registry reused by the V2 managers and fee helper.

prismRegistry.role: Maps supported Prism pair tokens to their active manager proxies.

prismQuoter.role: Read-only quoting for V2 Prism launch and purchase flows.

prismBuyer.role: Atomic V2 Prism launch and initial purchase helper.

prismNativeRouterV4.role: Native-asset entry and exit router through Uniswap v4.

prismNativeRouterV3.role: Native-asset entry and exit router through Uniswap v3.

nativeQuoter.role: Quotes current V2 Native launch and purchase flows.

nativeBuyer.role: Atomic current V2 Native launch and initial purchase helper.
